preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(0 <= p_i <= i for i, p_i in enumerate(p))
preconditions.description: The tree is described by n-1 parent indices p_i, where p_i is the parent of vertex i+1 (0-based), and 0 ≤ p_i ≤ i.

preconditions.expression: len(x) == n and all(x_i in {0, 1} for x_i in x)
preconditions.description: The color list x has exactly n elements, each being 0 (white) or 1 (black).
At least one vertex is colored black.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7 (modulo 1000000007).

The output is the number of ways to split the tree by removing k edges (0 ≤ k < n) such that each resulting connected component contains exactly one black vertex, modulo 1000000007. Here, count_valid_splits(n, p, x) is the function that computes this value.
